'''Tennelt''' was an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the brother of [[Deasie A'Fresel]], and defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanMale.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Officer Tennelt]]
Tennelt was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
